import warnings
from frameioclient import FrameioClient
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:

assert r.is_retry("POST", 429), "POST should be retried on 429"
assert not r.is_retry("PUT", 429), "PUT should not be retried"
r2 = r.increment(method="POST", url="/x")
assert r2.is_retry("POST", 429)
print("OK")
